    "$P213_CAPTURE_PYTHON" "$P213_CAPTURE_OBSERVER" \

    case "$P213_CAPTURE_VALUE" in
        /*) ;;

exec 3>&-

printf 'P213_OBSERVER_NATIVE_EXIT=%s\n' "$P213_CAPTURE_STATUS"
